simple.meaning: צִפֹּרֶן (tsippôren) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, a claw , i.e. (human) nail ; also the point of a style (or pen, tipped with adamant).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צִפֹּרֶן (H6856) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 21:12, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צִפֹּרֶן (H6856) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צִפֹּרֶן (H6856) before moving outward to related references.
